text: BAM's share of Solana stake held flat at 39.1% (169.4M SOL) over the past 25 hours. Just 4 of the 16 live nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 22.3% and 91 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. The top node by stake changed hands 69 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
